claim: Intra-operator parallelism (tensor parallelism) always has large communication volume and cannot scale to multiple nodes, while inter-operator parallelism (pipeline parallelism) suffers from pipeline bubbles.
stance_target: the claim that TP is ruled out on a fabric with no fast intra-node tier, since TP's communication volume is intrinsically large and it is normally confined to NVLink domains
quoted_support: Intra-op parallelism always has large communication volume, and cannot scale to multiple nodes, while inter-op parallelism suffers from bubbles.

claim: Combining TP and PP creates a cross-mesh resharding pattern that cannot be expressed with existing collective or P2P primitives, so specialized broadcast-based communication is needed.
stance_target: the claim that hybrid TP+PP topologies carry extra, non-obvious communication cost beyond the sum of their parts
scope_conditions: Composite intra-op + inter-op parallelism plans; tensors sharded on one mesh and required with a different layout on another
quoted_support: Since the communication happens from one group of devices to the other group, it cannot be implemented by directly using existing collective communication primitives. At the same time, because the tensor may have a different layout on the destination mesh, the communication also cannot be directly addressed by P2P communication primitives.

claim: Broadcast-based resharding outperforms existing approaches by up to 10x on microbenchmarks across tensor and mesh layouts.
stance_target: the size of the win available from better collective choice when the fabric is the bottleneck
scope_conditions: Cross-mesh resharding microbenchmarks; AWS p3.8xlarge nodes, 4x V100-16GB, 10 Gbps cross-node
quoted_support: On microbenchmarks, our overall system outperforms existing ones by up to 10x across various tensor and mesh layouts.

claim: End-to-end multi-node training gains from better model-parallel communication are 10% on GPT and 50% on U-Transformer.
stance_target: how much of end-to-end model-parallel throughput is actually recoverable by communication optimization
scope_conditions: Multi-node training of GPT and U-Transformer on V100 nodes
quoted_support: On end-to-end multi-node training of two models, GPT and U-Transformer, we improve throughput by 10% and 50%, respectively.

claim: Deep-learning clusters have heterogeneous networking hardware (NVLink, PCIe, NIC, InfiniBand), producing uneven bandwidth that model-parallel communication must route around.
stance_target: the claim that a PCIe-only box is the degenerate case of this hierarchy, where every route is the slow one
scope_conditions: Typical GPU cluster with intra-node NVLink and inter-node Ethernet/InfiniBand
quoted_support: A deep learning cluster contains heterogeneous networking hardware: NVLink, PICe, NIC, InfiniBand, etc.; this results in uneven bandwidth when devices communicate within and across meshes.

claim: The paper assumes fast intra-node NVLink and slow inter-node Ethernet/InfiniBand, fully connected nodes with uniform pairwise bandwidth, a host NIC bottleneck, and full-duplex send/receive.
stance_target: the transferability limit of these optimizations to a no-P2P, PCIe Gen2 x4 fabric where the host NIC assumption and full-duplex assumption may not hold
quoted_support: Fast intra-node and slow inter-node communication. ... Communication bottleneck at hosts. The bandwidth of a device (e.g., GPU) is often much higher than its host.

claim: Model-parallel jobs contain many cross-mesh resharding tasks triggered whenever one mesh's computation depends on another mesh's results, and their placement determines overall cost.
stance_target: the claim that TP+PP hybrids multiply communication events, which is the mechanism behind 'TP is ruled out' on a slow fabric
quoted_support: An entire model-parallel job contains many cross-mesh resharding tasks, which are triggered whenever one mesh's computation depends on another mesh's results.

claim: In the paper's testbed, AlpaComm is 3x to 10x faster than baseline resharding implementations on individual communication cases.
stance_target: the per-case magnitude of communication inefficiency in stock model-parallel implementations
scope_conditions: AWS p3.8xlarge, 4x V100-16GB per node, 10 Gbps cross-node

stance_target: the claim that overlap, not raw bandwidth, is the main lever for hiding collective cost
quoted_support: AlpaComm shows a 1.1x speedup because of overlapping. ... and achieve a 1.5x speedup compared to Alpa.
